title: The Distant Colony
author: August Montrose
blurb: Ansel Lockridge, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
